s_lib.config_screen.remove_entry.desc: Removes this entry when you save the screen.
s_lib.config_screen.add_entry.desc: Adds an entry with the default values. Save the screen to keep it.
s_lib.config_screen.add_map_entry.desc: Adds an entry with the key typed in New Entry Key and the default values. Save the screen to keep it.
s_lib.config_screen.new_key.desc: The key of the entry that Add Entry creates. It cannot be blank or a key the map already has.
s_lib.config_screen.comma_list: Separate the entries with commas. Put an entry in double quotes to keep a comma or the spaces around it: "Hello, world". Inside quotes, write \" for a quote and \\ for a backslash.
